70  /* Macros for encoding/decoding superblock */
    71  #define H5F_MAX_DRVINFOBLOCK_SIZE 1024 /* Maximum size of superblock driver info buffer */
    72  #define H5F_DRVINFOBLOCK_HDR_SIZE 16   /* Size of superblock driver info header */
    73
    74  /* Superblock sizes for various versions */
    75  #define H5F_SIZEOF_CHKSUM 4 /* Checksum size in the file */
    76
    77  /* Fixed-size portion at the beginning of all superblocks */
    78  #define H5F_SUPERBLOCK_FIXED_SIZE (H5F_SIGNATURE_LEN + 1) /* superblock version */
    79
    80  /* The H5F_SUPERBLOCK_MINIMAL_VARLEN_SIZE is the minimal amount of super block
    81   * variable length data guaranteed to load the sizeof offsets and the sizeof
    82   * lengths fields in all versions of the superblock.
    83   *
    84   * This is necessary in the V3 cache, as on the initial load, we need to
    85   * get enough of the superblock to determine its version and size so that
    86   * the metadata cache can load the correct amount of data from file to
    87   * allow the second deserialization attempt to succeed.
    88   *
    89   * The value selected will have to be revisited for each new version
    90   * of the super block.  Note that the current value is one byte larger
    91   * than it needs to be.
    92   */
    93  #define H5F_SUPERBLOCK_MINIMAL_VARLEN_SIZE 7
    94
    95  /* Macros for computing variable-size superblock size */
    96  #define H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE_COMMON                                                                    \
    97      (2    /* freespace, and root group versions */                                                           \
    98       + 1  /* reserved */                                                                                     \
    99       + 3  /* shared header vers, size of address, size of lengths */                                         \
   100       + 1  /* reserved */                                                                                     \
   101       + 4  /* group leaf k, group internal k */                                                               \
   102       + 4) /* consistency flags */
   103  #define H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE_V0(sizeof_addr, sizeof_size)                                              \
   104      (H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE_COMMON             /* Common variable-length info */                         \
   105       + (sizeof_addr)                               /* base address */                                        \
   106       + (sizeof_addr)                               /* <unused> */                                            \
   107       + (sizeof_addr)                               /* EOF address */                                         \
   108       + (sizeof_addr)                               /* driver block address */                                \
   109       + H5G_SIZEOF_ENTRY(sizeof_addr, sizeof_size)) /* root group ptr */
   110  #define H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE_V1(sizeof_addr, sizeof_size)                                              \
   111      (H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE_COMMON             /* Common variable-length info */                         \
   112       + 2                                           /* indexed B-tree internal k */                           \
   113       + 2                                           /* reserved */                                            \
   114       + (sizeof_addr)                               /* base address */                                        \
   115       + (sizeof_addr)                               /* <unused> */                                            \
   116       + (sizeof_addr)                               /* EOF address */                                         \
   117       + (sizeof_addr)                               /* driver block address */                                \
   118       + H5G_SIZEOF_ENTRY(sizeof_addr, sizeof_size)) /* root group ptr */
   119  #define H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE_V2(sizeof_addr)                                                           \
   120      (2                    /* size of address, size of lengths */                                             \
   121       + 1                  /* consistency flags */                                                            \
   122       + (sizeof_addr)      /* base address */                                                                 \
   123       + (sizeof_addr)      /* superblock extension address */                                                 \
   124       + (sizeof_addr)      /* EOF address */                                                                  \
   125       + (sizeof_addr)      /* root group object header address */                                             \
   126       + H5F_SIZEOF_CHKSUM) /* superblock checksum (keep this last) */
   127  #define H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE(v, sizeof_addr, sizeof_size)                                              \
   128      ((v == 0 ? H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE_V0(sizeof_addr, sizeof_size) : 0) +                                \
   129       (v == 1 ? H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE_V1(sizeof_addr, sizeof_size) : 0) +                                \
   130       (v >= 2 ? H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE_V2(sizeof_addr) : 0))
   131
   132  /* Total size of superblock, depends on superblock version */
   133  #define H5F_SUPERBLOCK_SIZE(s)                                                                               \
   134      (H5F_SUPERBLOCK_FIXED_SIZE +                                                                             \
   135       H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE((s)->super_vers, (s)->sizeof_addr, (s)->sizeof_size))
   136
   137  /* For superblock version 0 & 1:
   138     Offset to the file consistency flags (status_flags) in the superblock (excluding H5F_SUPERBLOCK_FIXED_SIZE)
   139   */
   140  #define H5F_SUPER_STATUS_OFF_V01                                                                             \
   141      (unsigned)(2    /* freespace, and root group versions */                                                 \
   142                 + 1  /* reserved */                                                                           \
   143                 + 3  /* shared header vers, size of address, size of lengths */                               \
   144                 + 1  /* reserved */                                                                           \
   145                 + 4) /* group leaf k, group internal k */
   146
   147  #define H5F_SUPER_STATUS_OFF(v) (v >= 2 ? (unsigned)2 : H5F_SUPER_STATUS_OFF_V01)
   148
   149  /* Offset to the file consistency flags (status_flags) in the superblock */
   150  #define H5F_SUPER_STATUS_FLAGS_OFF(v) (H5F_SUPERBLOCK_FIXED_SIZE + H5F_SUPER_STATUS_OFF(v))
   151
   152  /* Size of file consistency flags (status_flags) in the superblock */
   153  #define H5F_SUPER_STATUS_FLAGS_SIZE(v) (v >= 2 ? 1 : 4)
   154
   155  /* Forward declaration external file cache struct used below (defined in
   130
   131  /*******************/
   132  /* Local Variables */
   133  /*******************/
   134
   135  /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   136   * Function:    H5F__superblock_prefix_decode
   137   *
   138   * Purpose:     Decode a superblock prefix
   139   *
   140   * Return:      Non-negative on success/Negative on failure
   141   *
   142   * Programmer:  Quincey Koziol
   143   *              December 15, 2016
   144   *
   145   *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   146   */
   147  static herr_t
   148  H5F__superblock_prefix_decode(H5F_super_t *sblock, const uint8_t **image_ref,
   149                                const H5F_superblock_cache_ud_t *udata, hbool_t extend_eoa)
   150  {
   151      const uint8_t *image     = (const uint8_t *)*image_ref; /* Pointer into raw data buffer */
   152      htri_t         ret_value = SUCCEED;                     /* Return value */
   153
   154      FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE
   155
   156      /* Check arguments */
   157      HDassert(sblock);
   158      HDassert(image_ref);
   159      HDassert(image);
   160      HDassert(udata);
   161      HDassert(udata->f);
   162
   163      /* Skip over signature (already checked when locating the superblock) */
   164      image += H5F_SIGNATURE_LEN;
   165
   166      /* Superblock version */
   167      sblock->super_vers = *image++;
   168      if (sblock->super_vers > HDF5_SUPERBLOCK_VERSION_LATEST)
   169          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_FILE, H5E_BADVALUE, FAIL, "bad superblock version number")
   170
   171      /* Sanity check */
   172      HDassert(((size_t)(image - (const uint8_t *)*image_ref)) == H5F_SUPERBLOCK_FIXED_SIZE);
   173
   174      /* Determine the size of addresses & size of offsets, for computing the
   175       * variable-sized portion of the superblock.
   176       */
   177      if (sblock->super_vers < HDF5_SUPERBLOCK_VERSION_2) {
   178          sblock->sizeof_addr = image[4];
   179          sblock->sizeof_size = image[5];
   180      } /* end if */
   181      else {
   182          sblock->sizeof_addr = image[0];
   183          sblock->sizeof_size = image[1];
   184      } /* end else */
   185      if (sblock->sizeof_addr != 2 && sblock->sizeof_addr != 4 && sblock->sizeof_addr != 8 &&
   186          sblock->sizeof_addr != 16 && sblock->sizeof_addr != 32)
   187          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_FILE, H5E_BADVALUE, FAIL, "bad byte number in an address")
   188      if (sblock->sizeof_size != 2 && sblock->sizeof_size != 4 && sblock->sizeof_size != 8 &&
   189          sblock->sizeof_size != 16 && sblock->sizeof_size != 32)
   190          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_FILE, H5E_BADVALUE, FAIL, "bad byte number for object size")
   191
   192      /* Check for extending the EOA for the file */
   193      if (extend_eoa) {
   194          size_t variable_size; /* Variable size of superblock */
   195
   196          /* Determine the size of the variable-length part of the superblock */
   197          variable_size =
   198              (size_t)H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE(sblock->super_vers, sblock->sizeof_addr, sblock->sizeof_size);
   199          HDassert(variable_size > 0);
   200
   201          /* Make certain we can read the variable-sized portion of the superblock */
   202          if (H5F__set_eoa(udata->f, H5FD_MEM_SUPER, (haddr_t)(H5F_SUPERBLOCK_FIXED_SIZE + variable_size)) < 0)
   203              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_FILE, H5E_CANTINIT, FAIL, "set end of space allocation request failed")
   204      } /* end if */
   205
   206      /* Update the image buffer pointer */
   207      *image_ref = image;
   208
   209  done:
   210      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
   211  } /* end H5F__superblock_prefix_decode() */
   212
   213  /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   214   * Function:    H5F__drvrinfo_prefix_decode
   215   *
   216   * Purpose:     Decode a driver info prefix
   217   *
   218   * Return:      Non-negative on success/Negative on failure
   219   *
   220   * Programmer:  Quincey Koziol
   221   *              December 15, 2016
   222   *
   223   *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   224   */
   225  static herr_t
   226  H5F__drvrinfo_prefix_decode(H5O_drvinfo_t *drvrinfo, char *drv_name, const uint8_t **image_ref,
   227                              H5F_drvrinfo_cache_ud_t *udata, hbool_t extend_eoa)
   228  {
   229      const uint8_t *image = (const uint8_t *)*image_ref; /* Pointer into raw data buffer */
   230      unsigned       drv_vers;                            /* Version of driver info block */
   300      FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE_NOERR
   301
   302      /* Check arguments */
   303      HDassert(image_len);
   304
   305      /* Set the initial image length size */
   306      *image_len = H5F_SUPERBLOCK_FIXED_SIZE + /* Fixed size of superblock */
   307                   H5F_SUPERBLOCK_MINIMAL_VARLEN_SIZE;
   308
   309      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(SUCCEED)
   310  } /* end H5F__cache_superblock_get_initial_load_size() */
   311
   312  /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   313   * Function:    H5F__cache_superblock_get_final_load_size
   314   *
   315   * Purpose:     Compute the final size of the data structure on disk.
   316   *
   317   * Return:      Non-negative on success/Negative on failure
   318   *
   319   * Programmer:  Quincey Koziol
   320   *              November 17, 2016
   321   *
   322   *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   323   */
   324  static herr_t
   325  H5F__cache_superblock_get_final_load_size(const void *_image, size_t H5_ATTR_NDEBUG_UNUSED image_len,
   326                                            void *_udata, size_t *actual_len)
   327  {
   328      const uint8_t             *image = _image;                              /* Pointer into raw data buffer */
   329      H5F_superblock_cache_ud_t *udata = (H5F_superblock_cache_ud_t *)_udata; /* User data */
   330      H5F_super_t                sblock;                                      /* Temporary file superblock */
   331      htri_t                     ret_value = SUCCEED;                         /* Return value */
   332
   333      FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE
   334
   335      /* Check arguments */
   336      HDassert(image);
   337      HDassert(udata);
   338      HDassert(actual_len);
   339      HDassert(*actual_len == image_len);
   340      HDassert(image_len >= H5F_SUPERBLOCK_FIXED_SIZE + 6);
   341
   342      /* Deserialize the file superblock's prefix */
   343      if (H5F__superblock_prefix_decode(&sblock, &image, udata, TRUE) < 0)
   344          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_FILE, H5E_CANTDECODE, FAIL, "can't decode file superblock prefix")
   345
   346      /* Save the version to be used in verify_chksum callback */
   347      udata->super_vers = sblock.super_vers;
   348
   349      /* Set the final size for the cache image */
   350      *actual_len = H5F_SUPERBLOCK_FIXED_SIZE + (size_t)H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE(
   351                                                    sblock.super_vers, sblock.sizeof_addr, sblock.sizeof_size);
   352
   353  done:
   354      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
   355  } /* end H5F__cache_superblock_get_final_load_size() */
   356
   357  /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   358   * Function:    H5F__cache_superblock_verify_chksum
   359   *
   360   * Purpose:     Verify the computed checksum of the data structure is the
   361   *              same as the stored chksum.
   362   *
   363   * Return:      Success:        TRUE/FALSE
   364   *              Failure:        Negative
   365   *
   366   * Programmer:  Vailin Choi; Aug 2015
   367   *
   368   *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   369   */
   370  static htri_t
   371  H5F__cache_superblock_verify_chksum(const void *_image, size_t len, void *_udata)
   372  {
   373      const uint8_t             *image = _image;                              /* Pointer into raw data buffer */
   374      H5F_superblock_cache_ud_t *udata = (H5F_superblock_cache_ud_t *)_udata; /* User data */
   375      uint32_t                   stored_chksum;    /* Stored metadata checksum value */
   376      uint32_t                   computed_chksum;  /* Computed metadata checksum value */
   377      htri_t                     ret_value = TRUE; /* Return value */
   378
   379      FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE_NOERR
   380
   381      /* Check arguments */
   382      HDassert(image);
   383      HDassert(udata);
   384
   385      /* No checksum for version 0 & 1 */
   386      if (udata->super_vers >= HDF5_SUPERBLOCK_VERSION_2) {
   387
   388          /* Get stored and computed checksums */
   389          H5F_get_checksums(image, len, &stored_chksum, &computed_chksum);
   390
   391          if (stored_chksum != computed_chksum)
   392              ret_value = FALSE;
   393      } /* end if */
   394
   395      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
   410   */
   411  static void *
   412  H5F__cache_superblock_deserialize(const void *_image, size_t H5_ATTR_NDEBUG_UNUSED len, void *_udata,
   413                                    hbool_t H5_ATTR_UNUSED *dirty)
   414  {
   415      H5F_super_t               *sblock    = NULL;                                /* File's superblock */
   416      H5F_superblock_cache_ud_t *udata     = (H5F_superblock_cache_ud_t *)_udata; /* User data */
   417      const uint8_t             *image     = _image; /* Pointer into raw data buffer */
   418      H5F_super_t               *ret_value = NULL;   /* Return value */
   419
   420      FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE
   421
   422      /* Check arguments */
   423      HDassert(image);
   424      HDassert(udata);
   425      HDassert(udata->f);
   426      HDassert(len >= H5F_SUPERBLOCK_FIXED_SIZE + 6);
   427
   428      /* Allocate space for the superblock */
   429      if (NULL == (sblock = H5FL_CALLOC(H5F_super_t)))
   430          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
   431
   432      /* Deserialize the file superblock's prefix */
   433      if (H5F__superblock_prefix_decode(sblock, &image, udata, FALSE) < 0)
   434          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_FILE, H5E_CANTDECODE, NULL, "can't decode file superblock prefix")
   435
   436      /* Check for older version of superblock format */
   437      if (sblock->super_vers < HDF5_SUPERBLOCK_VERSION_2) {
   438          uint32_t status_flags;  /* File status flags       */
   439          unsigned sym_leaf_k;    /* Symbol table leaf node's 'K' value */
   440          unsigned snode_btree_k; /* B-tree symbol table internal node 'K' value */
   441          unsigned chunk_btree_k; /* B-tree chunk internal node 'K' value */
   442
   443          /* Freespace version (hard-wired) */
   444          if (HDF5_FREESPACE_VERSION != *image++)
   445              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_FILE, H5E_BADVALUE, NULL, "bad free space version number")
   446
   447          /* Root group version number (hard-wired) */
   448          if (HDF5_OBJECTDIR_VERSION != *image++)
   449              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_FILE, H5E_BADVALUE, NULL, "bad object directory version number")
   450
   451          /* Skip over reserved byte */
   452          image++;
   453
   454          /* Shared header version number (hard-wired) */
   455          if (HDF5_SHAREDHEADER_VERSION != *image++)
   700          /* Encode the driver information block address */
   701          H5F_addr_encode(f, &image, sblock->driver_addr);
   702
   703          /* Encode the root group object entry, including the cached stab info */
   704          if (H5G_ent_encode(f, &image, sblock->root_ent) < 0)
   705              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_FILE, H5E_CANTENCODE, FAIL, "can't encode root group symbol table entry")
   706
   707          /* NOTE: Driver info block is handled separately */
   708
   709      }                         /* end if */
   710      else {                    /* sblock->super_vers >= HDF5_SUPERBLOCK_VERSION_2 */
   711          uint32_t   chksum;    /* Checksum temporary variable      */
   712          H5O_loc_t *root_oloc; /* Pointer to root group's object location */
   713
   714          /* Size of file addresses & offsets, and status flags */
   715          *image++ = sblock->sizeof_addr;
   716          *image++ = sblock->sizeof_size;
   717          *image++ = sblock->status_flags;
   718
   719          /* Encode the base address */
   720          H5F_addr_encode(f, &image, sblock->base_addr);
   721
   722          /* Encode the address of the superblock extension */
   723          H5F_addr_encode(f, &image, sblock->ext_addr);
   724
   725          /* At this point in time, the EOF value itself may
   726           * not be reflective of the file's size, since we'll eventually
   727           * truncate it to match the EOA value. As such, use the EOA value
   728           * in its place, knowing that the current EOF value will
   729           * ultimately match it. */
   730          if ((rel_eof = H5FD_get_eoa(f->shared->lf, H5FD_MEM_SUPER)) == HADDR_UNDEF)
   731              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_CANTGET, FAIL, "driver get_eoa request failed")
   732          H5F_addr_encode(f, &image, (rel_eof + sblock->base_addr));
   733
   734          /* Retrieve information for root group */
   735          if (NULL == (root_oloc = H5G_oloc(f->shared->root_grp)))
   736              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_FILE, H5E_CANTINIT, FAIL, "unable to retrieve root group information")
   737
   738          /* Encode address of root group's object header */
   739          H5F_addr_encode(f, &image, root_oloc->addr);
   740
   741          /* Compute superblock checksum */
   742          chksum = H5_checksum_metadata(_image, ((size_t)H5F_SUPERBLOCK_SIZE(sblock) - H5F_SIZEOF_CHKSUM), 0);
   743
   744          /* Superblock checksum */
   745          UINT32ENCODE(image, chksum);
   746
   747          /* Sanity check */
   748          HDassert((size_t)(image - (uint8_t *)_image) == (size_t)H5F_SUPERBLOCK_SIZE(sblock));
   749      } /* end else */
   750
